habitat: 농촌, 농경지, 구릉지, 야산 노거수의 구멍
summary: 농촌과 농경지, 구릉지, 야산에서 오래된 큰 나무의 구멍에 깃드는 흔하지 않은 여름철새이다. 혼자 또는 암수가 함께 지내며 주로 땅 위에서 생활한다. 4~6월에 알을 5~8개 낳는다. 곤충 애벌레를 즐겨 먹고 거미, 지렁이 따위도 먹으며, 국내에서는 중부 이북에 살고 국외에서는 아프리카와 유라시아 전역에 분포한다.

art.subject: Common Hoopoe (Upupa epops), adult as seen in Korean farmland from April to September: head, neck and breast soft pinkish-buff, the chin and upper throat edged whitish; a large fan-shaped erectile crest of long pinkish-buff feathers, each tipped black, the rear feathers with a white band before the black tip; mantle pinkish- to greyish-brown; wings black boldly barred with broad creamy-white bands; lower back and upper rump banded creamy white and blackish-brown; uppertail coverts black; tail black with a broad white band across the middle; belly whitish, the flanks lightly streaked dark. Bill long, slender, gently decurved and black; brown iris; legs grey.
art.pose: walking on the ground with the crest raised
art.scene: Korean countryside in summer: farmland and low hills with a large old tree; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view on the ground: crest raised and fanned, pinkish-buff head and breast, black wings boldly barred white, banded lower back, long decurved black bill, grey legs
adult, head close-up in side view with the crest fanned: long pinkish-buff crest feathers tipped black, the rear ones with a white band before the black tip
adult in flight seen from above: broad rounded black wings crossed by bold white bars, black-and-white banded lower back, black tail with a broad white band across the middle
art.build: Medium-sized, slim ground bird, about 28cm, about the length of a Brown-eared Bulbul, with a long, slender, gently decurved bill clearly longer than the head and a large fan crest that is usually folded back into a point but raised on landing or when alarmed. Legs short, grey; walks and probes on bare ground and short grass. Wings broad and rounded; flight slow and undulating like a giant butterfly, flashing the black-and-white wings. Tail medium length, square-ended.
avoid: Do not paint a short or straight bill; it is long, slender and gently decurved.
Do not paint plain brown wings; they are black with broad white bars.
Do not paint crest feathers without black tips, or the body bright orange.
Do not paint a long tail; it is of medium length and square-ended.
